description: Header file defining classes, enums, and functions related to logic expression evaluation in firmware, including LEElement, LEElementPool, LECalculator, and related enums and constants.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element in a logic expression, with action and value fields.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects for parsing expressions.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Performs calculation of logic expressions using a stack-based approach.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Associates action enums with string names, linked list structure.

methods.description: Constructor for LEElement.

methods.description: Resets the LEElement to default state.

methods.description: Initializes LEElement with an action and optional value.

methods.name: LEElementPool
methods.description: Constructor for LEElementPool.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next available LEElement from the pool.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the pool to initial state.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a string expression into LEElement list.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns size of the pool.

methods.name: LECalculator
methods.description: Constructor for LECalculator.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates value based on selfValue and expression.

methods.description: Calculates value with a specific list of elements.

methods.description: Adds an element to the calculation.

methods.description: Resets the calculator state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator with a specific element.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an action and value onto the stack.

methods.name: processElement
methods.description: Processes an element during calculation.

methods.name: pop

methods.name: getNextToken

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a line represents a numeric value.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses a line into an action enum.

methods.name: float2bool
